verification_plan.verification_scope: SEL health, guarded raw archive/clear, durable identity/retention/state, security and native clock

REQ-SEL-001: Current full/near-full/logging enabled/disabled states come from real adapter response parsing; logging not inferred from historical events.
Each observation has independent freshness/identity; unknown/stale/missing capacity cannot claim healthy/full/percentage trigger.
Near-full90% warns; confirmed full alone can trigger opted-in clear; simultaneous conditions remain visible by machine name/IP.
REQ-SEL-002: All clear entrypoints share one service; complete raw snapshot and independent audit/receipt commit before dispatch.
Same raw reservation is used on every final record traversal and clear; fresh-reservation standalone utility never called.
Partial/page/undecodable-without-raw/storage/quota/commit/audit/reservation loss prevent writes; raw undecodable bytes preserved.
Invalidation by new event/competing owner gives bounded recollection; post-clear new records survive; command exit alone cannot declare completion.
REQ-SEL-003: Database ownership enforces one target/log writer across independent sessions/workers, shared by clear and clock.
Restart/timeouts reconcile durable intent before any mutation; ambiguous effects never blindly retry.
All event producer/dedup paths preserve reset/external-clear/replacement/reused-ID evidence and replay dedup; timestamps alone never key events.
Compatible SQLite migration preserves every row/column and removes obsolete unique constraint with rollback on failure.
Trusted collection/archive age preserves configured retention duration; pending/reconciling archive and independent audit survive explicit history deletion.
REQ-SEL-004: Current admin plus session-bound CSRF and exact trusted-origin guard all POSTs including old routes/bulk; direct and authenticated Fleet base paths work.
Configured active stable identity resolved before secret/network; independent policies default off; consent revisions revoke queued work and recheck at dispatch.
Each target uses complete username+secret; fixed authenticated IPMI commands use -E invocation-local environment; no -P fallback or unsafe errors/logging.
Both template trees safely display BMC-controlled text/names/errors with fixed enums; actual browser payload creates no executable elements.
Enable modifies only qualified bit, preserves all others and requires enabled readback. Unqualified/ambiguous devices cannot mutate.
REQ-SEL-005: Trusted fresh synchronized UTC reference required; local wall clock alone is insufficient; healthy/unhealthy external NTP remains externally managed.
Uninitialized/incorrect native dates yield warning and accurate quality; no ambiguous timezone/offset/reference write.
Qualified offset-capable clock positive/negative native mapping sets time then restores offset reset by time write and verifies both within tolerance.
Failure between writes and timeout stays incomplete/outcome-unknown and reconciles without blind retry.
Clock owner shared with clear; invalidates stale snapshot epoch; raw original/native dates and independent before/after/desired audit retained. No OS/Mac/GPU clock mutation.
